levels.surface: حسن بن عبد الله بن محمد بن عيسى

notes: The leading «13» is the report number: left out. «أبي» is the compiler's own father, a relation with no name
«قال سمعته يقول» : the Imam is already the last link of the first chain (the pronoun «سمعته» refers to him), so no link is added
The second «حَدَّثَنِي حَسَنُ» comes after the saying: a second isnad of the same saying (rule 4); «بِإِسْنَادِهِ» is written as a back_reference link
